goal: Give the exact-head approval gate a required minimum slot count derived from the pull request's own changed files, so a never-drawn slot 2 on a migration change fails loudly instead of being invisible (PR #2746 merged on one approval).
prohibited_actions: No database write or structure change of any kind
No weakening of any existing refusal, of the documents-only lane, of the returned-slot rule, or of the carry-forward rules
No change to any migration file or workflow file
assumptions: AGENTS.md 6.x section 4 is the authority for the count: migrations need two independent reviews, scripts/docs/CI one
A pull request that touches supabase/migrations/ is a migration change for this purpose, judged from the same changed-file list the documents-only lane reads, renames carrying their previous name
changedFiles absent entirely keeps the previous one-slot behavior for callers that predate the field, mirroring the documents-only lane convention
stop_conditions: Stop and report if any existing test shows a change that touches supabase/migrations/ legitimately merging with fewer than two drawn review slots
Stop if the returned-slot or carry-forward enforcement would need to be weakened to admit the minimum
